symptom: README says the app uses 'facebook/bart-large-mnli' but the actual model loaded is 'cross-encoder/nli-distilroberta-base'. Misleads contributors about hardware requirements and model behaviour.

fix: Update README.md — replace all references to 'facebook/bart-large-mnli' with 'cross-encoder/nli-distilroberta-base'. Also update the model size note (~500 MB is correct for the CrossEncoder).
